title: 第19章 登临黄府各自献礼第20章 二阶传承祖训约定
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
难得他祖父今日这般空闲，陈景安又问出了自己的另外一个疑惑。
同样也是他最担心的事情。
“祖父，不知那个一直在逃的魔修可是落网了？”
老爷子是当日唯二出手的大修。
同时，他也是最后对那位魔修动手之人，具体的情况他知道的应该比别人多。
提及魔修，老爷子同样神情凝重：“那魔修的实力不弱于我，就连王楚恒都差点栽在那人的手里。
他当日被我重创，可魔修的恢复力要远超于寻常修士，只怕用不了多久就能恢复。”
陈景安这下是真被吓住了。
娘的。
这下他岂不是还得把妻儿藏在外头？
不料，老爷子这时却笑了起来。
“你这小子真怕死，不过这也不是坏事。
罢了，告诉你实话。”
“上回那魔修当众杀了三位仙族修士，再算上他先前覆灭的凌河县张氏，这已经达到了能惊动镇魔司的程度。
我们四家凑了二十块灵石，一并给郑家的管事送去，请他代为上禀。”
“不出意外的话，镇魔司已经派出人来追杀那魔修了。”
陈景安听到这话，总算放下心来。
他已经受够了这种提心吊胆的日子.
马车快要到黄府。
陈景安忽然又问了一句：“祖父，孙儿需要韬光养晦一下么？”

老爷子闻言一愣，转而笑着在他脑门上敲了一下：“少做这些多余的。
你与景扬是同族，你若出息了，对他的裨益也大，把眼光放长远点。”
陈景安确认自己不会喧宾夺主，这才放心点头。
……
等到一行人进了黄府。
黄符师早已带着陈景扬，以及他的另外一个徒弟“黄平”
恭候在此。
黄符师本身也是一位练气八层。
他作为老牌符师，不论财力还是掌握的灵符数量，都远超一般的练气八层，打斗起来生死未知。
便是陈老爷子这样的仙族之主，在他面前也不会拿乔。
双方互相寒暄。
身为典史的陈大伯今日没了官样，看到儿子大笑着上前，与那些为儿子骄傲的父亲一般无二，甚至更加激动。
陈景安可以理解这种激动。
毕竟，二堂哥现在已经能算“符师”
的预备役了。
等他可以完全掌握灵符的制法，就会成为族里的第一位符师。
只要有二堂哥在，大房的其他几脉至少在接下来的两代里，不用担心会被边缘化，都能跟着沾光。
content_en:
It was rare that his grandfather was so free today, so Chen Jingan asked another question of his.
It's also what worries him the most.
"Grandpa, I wonder if the demon cultivator who has been on the run has been caught?"
The old man was the only overhaul that day.
At the same time, he was also the last person to take action against the demon cultivator. He should know more about the specific situation than others.
When mentioning the demon cultivator, the old man also looked solemn: "The demon cultivator's strength is not weaker than mine, and even Wang Chuheng almost fell into that person's hands.
He was severely injured by me that day, but the recovery power of the demon cultivator is far superior to that of ordinary monks. I'm afraid it won't take long to recover. "
Chen Jingan was really frightened now.
Damn it.
Doesn't he have to hide his wife and children outside now?
Unexpectedly, the old man laughed at this time.
“You kid is really afraid of death, but that’s not a bad thing.
Just tell you the truth. "
"Last time, the demon cultivator killed three immortal cultivators in public, including the Zhang family in Linghe County that he had previously destroyed. This was enough to alarm the Demon Suppressor.
The four of us gathered together twenty spiritual stones and sent them to the steward of the Zheng family, asking him to submit the report on his behalf. "
"If nothing unexpected happens, the Demon Suppression Department has already sent people to hunt down the demon cultivator."
When Chen Jingan heard this, he finally felt relieved.
He has had enough of this kind of fearful life.
The carriage is about to arrive at Huang Mansion.
Chen Jingan suddenly asked again: "Grandpa, does my grandson need to hide his power and bide his time?"
The old man was stunned when he heard this, then smiled and knocked on his forehead: "Stop doing these unnecessary things.
You and Jing Yang are of the same race. If you make a career, it will be of great benefit to him. Take a long-term view. "
Chen Jingan confirmed that he would not overwhelm the guest, and then nodded with confidence.
…
Wait until a group of people entered Huang Mansion.
Master Huang Fu has already brought Chen Jingyang and his other apprentice "Huang Ping"
We are waiting here.
Master Huang Fu himself is also an eighth-level Qi practitioner.
As a veteran talisman master, his financial resources and the number of talismans he mastered far exceeded those of ordinary eighth-level qi practitioners, and his life or death in a fight was unknown.
Even the master of the immortal clan like Mr. Chen would not touch Qiao in front of him.
Both parties exchanged greetings.
Uncle Chen, who is a classics historian, lost his official appearance today. When he saw his son laughing and stepping forward, he was no different from those fathers who were proud of their sons, or even more excited.
Chen Jingan can understand this excitement.
After all, the second cousin can now be regarded as a "talisman master"
of reserve duty.
When he can fully master the method of making spiritual talismans, he will become the first talisman master in the clan.
As long as the second cousin is around, the other members of Dafang will be able to benefit from it, at least for the next two generations, without having to worry about being marginalized.
